Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted Wikipedia’s release information and concluded the film “came out” in 2010, likely conflating a home video/secondary date with the theatrical release. This ignored consistent evidence from multiple sources (e.g., Wikipedia lead, Rotten Tomatoes) showing a 2009 theatrical release (Sep 18, 2009).
